tools.name: find_kids_events
tools.description: Search upcoming family and kids events near a US city on KidsEventsThisWeek.com: library story times, museum days, camps, festivals, church kids programs and more. Useful for finding what to do with children this week, this weekend or on a given day. Takes a city and state, or a 5-digit US ZIP code

tools.name: get_kids_event
tools.description: Get the details of one event from KidsEventsThisWeek.com by its id, which is the last part of the event link (the text after /event/). Returns the date and time, venue, full address, organizer, price, age range, a short summary and the link to the event page, which has the full description and regis

tools.name: list_best_around_guides
tools.description: List the "Best Around" guides for a US city on KidsEventsThisWeek.com: hand-picked guides to local parks, playgrounds, splash pads, museums, free Christmas lights and similar places for families.
